* '''Original''' ([[Courage Of A Skywalker (V)]]): PC card image of 7 August 2025<ref name="ht-cs-0">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/7821822/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual25-Light/large/courageofaskywalker.gif courageofaskywalker.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/7821822 7821822] (7 August 2025).</ref>, no errata mark.  Text: “If a [Skywalker] Effect on table, destiny +2 when drawn for destiny. Take a lightsaber into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle. OR Retrieve Anakin's Lightsaber. OR Once per game, during a battle or duel involving a Skywalker and a Dark Jedi, make a just drawn destiny = 2.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Courage Of A Skywalker (V) (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 25 release sheet<ref name="sheet25-20250810">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF, 10 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, August 2025”; file created 10 August 2025). Released with [[Virtual Set 25]] (8 August 2025); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 8, file created 10 August 2025: “If a [Skywalker] Effect on table, destiny +2 when drawn for destiny. Take a lightsaber into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle. OR Retrieve Anakin's Lightsaber. OR Once per game, during a battle or duel involving a Skywalker and a Dark Jedi, make a just drawn destiny = 2.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Courage Of A Skywalker (V)]] (Original). The sheet prints a partial slip under the label “•Courage Of A Skywalker”: the lower part of the PC card image of [[Courage Of A Skywalker (V)]] (published 7 August 2025) — the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name — pixel for pixel the same, to be laid over the card named in its lower-left corner ([[Courage Of A Skywalker]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): PC card image of 9 March 2026<ref name="ht-cs-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6f23e07/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual25-Light/large/courageofaskywalker.gif courageofaskywalker.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6f23e07 6f23e07] (9 March 2026).</ref>, marked “E1”.
